title: Iquitos and the rubber boom: a city in the rainforest
goal: Talk about Iquitos and the rubber boom, using regrets and reproaches about your own trip and reading.
grammar: regrets and reproaches about the past

items: I can express regrets and reproaches with *debería haber* and *me arrepiento de haber* + participle.
I can say why Iquitos has no road and what the rubber boom was.
I can use the new words for the Amazon: *caucho*, *carretera*, *informe*, *selva*.
